verdict.rationale: stagewise is a chat-driven agentic IDE. Its docs describe visual debugging in which the agent takes screenshots and inspects what users see. The GitHub README says the agent has full access to the browser tab's console and debugger, and it can also run shell commands and interact with tabs via CDP, so developers can troubleshoot by asking the agent in natural language. Missing for 10: no in-depth documentation of a natural-language debugging workflow (e.g. stack-trace or log analysis, root-cause explanation), no hands-on or independent corroboration of debugging quality, and debugging evidence is mostly limited to the browser/frontend.
